title: Index: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Index loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Search broad terms first, then filter by category. Use item and recipe links from Wiki rather than trying to remember every path.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first useful Index search answers one practical question: what is this, where does it come from, what uses it, or why does this machine matter?

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Index is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
